course_name_original: Introduction to Blockchain and Decentralized Security
course_name_en: Introduction to Blockchain and Decentralized Security
prerequisites: cryptographic primitives (encryption methods, signatures, MACs, hash functions)

learning_outcomes.text: Reason about the security and privacy definitions of decentralized systems.
Explain the security of blockchains in light of the state of the art reported attacks.
Reason about possible network security and cryptographic countermeasures to deter attacks on decentralized platforms (blockchains and distributed platforms).

Explain best security/privacy practices to strengthen the security of existing blockchains and existing distributed learning platforms, and extract relevant lessons for the design of next-generation decentralized technologies.

syllabus_topics: Security and privacy of decentralized technologies
Basic security and privacy provisions of existing popular blockchains
State-of-the-art attacks and threats against existing systems/deployments
Effectiveness of combining network-level security primitives with novel cryptographic primitives to deter attacks on payment systems
Security of federated learning and distributed learning
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon passing the exam.
